title: Prospective multicenter clinical study to determine the clinical safety and efficacy of the embolizing fluid ihtOBTURA®
summary:
The investigational product ihtOBTURA® is a medical device under clinical investigation (hereinafter referred to as investigational product) and is being developed for the treatment  of arteriovenous pathologies. It is an embolizing fluid (blood vessel occluding) agent that is used in an intervention to seal the vascular damage. ihtOBTURA® is a permanent embolization agent so it is expected to last as long as the patient lives.
As part of the planned clinical investigation, the safety and performance of the investigational product will be examined. In particular, the extent to which it can seal the damaged vessels will be investigated. It will also be investigated wheter it is safe to use and whether complications occur. 
The investigational product will be applied during the procedure, which is performed according to hospital standards. The embolic fluid may be applied in one session or in multiple sessions as needed, at the doctor’s discretion. After the procedure, the participant will return to the study center three more times for check-ups. Routine exams will be done to see how successful the treatment has been.
The total duration of the study for each participant will be about six months from the last embolization session.
Based on previous research results, that treatment with ihtOBTURA® will help restore neuro-vascular function by embolizing the lesions.

interventions.name: Embolization according to the standard clinical procedure using the investigational device as the embolic agent (one or several sessions as needed)

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Patients and/or legal representative signing the informed consent form, indicating an understanding of the study protocol requirements and a willingness to participate in the study
- Patients with ruptured or unruptured AVMs with predictive factors for cerebral hemorrhage and candidates for treatment by percutaneous embolization
Exclusion criteria:
- Patients planned to receive surgery after the first embolization session
- Have other incompatibilities that prevent participation in the study (for example: be participating in another clinical trial at the same time)
- Pregnant or lactating women
- Patients with mRS = 3, 4, 5, 6
- Patients with known allergies to components according to contraindications (DMSO, iodine)
- Patients with significant hepatic, thyroid or renal dysfunction
